notes: The supplied antecedent they of they that swallowed thee up was given to the finite verb rachaqu as a subject pronoun. Rule 17 keeps a subject pronoun with its verb only where no explicit subject noun stands, and here the participial substantive is the explicit subject; rule 46 puts the supplied antecedent with that substantive, as the chapter does at 49.9, 49.17 and 49.26.
